p: over against the candlestick: To that part which is in the forefront of the candlestick, Ex 25:37.
according unto the pattern which the: And not set together of various pieces.
water of purifying upon them: In Hebrew it is called the water of sin, because it is made to purge sin, as in Nu 19:9.
whole assembly of the children of: That you may do this in the presence of them all.
children of Israel shall put their: Meaning, certain of them in the name of the whole.
children of Israel in the tabernacle: Which the Israelites should do.
sanctuary: Because the levites go into the sanctuary in their name.
